name: Alexander Schenker
headline: Product & Design
summary:
Product designer and leader with a multidisciplinary background in design, development, and product strategy. I bring a hybrid perspective that connects user needs, technical realities, and business goals.

Rooted in Human-Computer Interaction and product thinking, I pair technical fluency with design leadership to help shape product vision and drive meaningful outcomes.

positions.title: Director of Product Design
positions.description:
Scaled the Product Design org from 8 to 24, spanning Product Design, Research, and Learning Experience Design.
Spearheaded a complete overhaul of SoSafe’s e-learning product, accessible, mobile-first, and AI-enabled, resulting in significantly improved user experience and reduced time to ship for new content.
Elevated design from a support function to a core pillar in the product trio, driving strategic direction and innovation across teams.
Fostered a high-performing, collaborative team culture focused on quality, speed, and business impact.

positions.title: Director Design Operations
positions.description:
Joined as the first UX designer and individual contributor, responsible for all aspects of product design across the early Celonis platform
Progressively built and scaled the design organization from a one-person UX function to a multidisciplinary team of over 20 designers, researchers, and UX architects
Led global design operations and the design systems team, introducing scalable processes, tooling, and governance across the EMS platform
Served as Interim Director of User Research, embedding research into product strategy and cross-functional decision-making
Partnered closely with product and engineering to elevate design maturity, improve platform consistency, and accelerate delivery
